articles.title: AXA XL names Matthew Stitham as Americas casualty underwriting chief
articles.mainIdea: AXA XL names Matthew Stitham as Americas casualty underwriting chief
articles.summary: Life Insurance International: AXA XL names Matthew Stitham as Americas casualty underwriting chief. Based in San Francisco, Stitham will report to Donna Nadeau, AXA XL’s head of large commercial business.
